title: National Use-of-Force Data Collection
description: This collection provides data on law enforcement uses of force that result in the death of a person, serious bodily injury of a person, or when law enforcement discharges a firearm at or in the direction of a person.  In addition, law enforcement agencies can indicate months where no incidents meeting the above criteria occurred.

contactPoint.fn: Criminal Justice Information Services Division Federal Bureau of Investigation (USDOJ)

distribution.description: The Crime Data Explorer (CDE) is an online interactive data tool to access, view, and understand the massive amounts of Uniform Crime Reporting (UCR) data. The CDE displays national Use-of-Force data for years 2019 to present.
distribution.title: 2019 to Present: Crime Data Explorer Visualizations
